targets.title: The bounds of adult language acquisition: Blocking and learned attention
targets.evidence_quote: We closely replicated E&S2010’s experiment 1, a seminal, frequently cited, and theoretically important study, because no replication study has been able to confirm its findings.
targets.outcome_quote: Although results did not confirm the initial study’s findings due to performance in verb pretraining, findings are consistent with contemporary theories of (associative) learning.
